placement: Capability Pack: src/capabilities/store/ and its contract unit (limen.store, now version 2). storeCapability(options) registers the pack with an application namespace and size limits and offers limen.store version 2; storeCapability() with no options keeps offering version 1 with 0.7.1's fingerprint and behaviour, so existing engines and hosts are unaffected. Every database name an engine gives resolves inside the namespace; a value or transaction over its serialized-size limit is InvalidRequest before the database is touched; Opened reports the limits. The 0.7.1 contract is kept as a frozen copy to prove the v1 fingerprint. Bindings regenerated (TypeScript, F#, C#, Rust); the generated F#/C#/Rust files are not guardrail paths. A dev-only in-memory IndexedDB (fake-indexeddb) lets the namespace and limit rules run under node. Core, the kernel, contract/targets.json and every guardrail path are unchanged.
